response.overview: This film follows two men. One of them is believed to be the physical gateway to eternal life, possessing a mysterious nostril that serves as the only entrance to the afterlife. The other man becomes obsessed with reaching eternal life and is convinced that the only way to achieve it is by jumping through the nostril.  As his obsession grows, he dedicates every moment to finding a way inside. He builds strange contraptions, studies impossible theories, and attempts increasingly absurd stunts, all in pursuit of his goal. Meanwhile, the gateway man grows increasingly frustrated as he tries to live a normal life while being pursued by someone determined to launch himself into his nose.
response.tagline: "I'm going to jump into your nostril now..."
